Adobe.oa_pattern: 3 Coding Questions (1 Easy, 2 Medium/Hard). Focus on Arrays, DP, and Graphs. 90 minutes.
Adobe.preparation_tips: Adobe's OA is notorious for DP. Make sure to practice standard 2D DP problems.

Microsoft.oa_pattern: 2 Coding Questions. Usually string manipulation or basic graphs. 60 minutes.
Microsoft.preparation_tips: Focus heavily on edge cases. They want clean, production-ready code.

Amazon.oa_pattern: 2 Coding Questions + Work Style Assessment. 90 minutes.
Amazon.preparation_tips: Do not ignore the Leadership Principles (LP) assessment. It holds as much weight as the coding section.

Rubrik.oa_pattern: Hard OA. 3-4 questions, heavy on advanced DP and segment trees.
